summary: Phase-2 Accessibility batch verified on mobile web preview (390x844). All 4 items in the review request PASS: (1) GRANDPARENT SIMPLE HOME - login testdad@fam.com -> tab-more -> more-accessibility -> toggle-simple-home ON -> a11y-back -> tab-index shows the 6-tile grid; every required tile is present (simple-tile-family/messages/send/memories/birthdays/emergency). Tapping simple-tile-family navigates to /calendar (cal-prev / cal-next / fab-create-event visible), tapping simple-tile-emergency navigates to /emergency (sos-button + emergency-back visible). Toggling Simple Home OFF then returning to Home restores the FULL dashboard (simple-tile-* gone; home-search/home-customize/home-chat/home-avatar all present). (2) KIDS MODE - Registered a fresh account (kidtest+<rand>@fam.com / secret123) via POST /api/auth/register, logged in via the login form, chose 'Join a family' (join-family-option), entered the Sharma invite code 9651EDC0 (invite-code-input + join-continue-btn), claimed the CHILD pending profile 'Aarav' via claim-mem_bcbcab87d36f4846, tapped join-family-submit and landed on '/' as a child member. The Home tab renders KidsHome: greeting 'Hi Aarav', a 'Today' card (Doctor Appointment 11:00), 'My Chores' with 4 rows (kids-chore-<id> x4, Make Bed / Feed Bruno / Homework / Put Clothes Away), and 'Quick Actions' with kids-send-love + kids-chat + kids-wishlist + TWO kids-hug-<parentId> tiles (Hug Raj, Hug Priya). Tapping kids-chore-<id> for Make Bed toggled the done count from '1 of 4 done' to '0 of 4 done' with the StarBurst celebration overlay and NO crash / red-screen. The bottom tab bar for the child correctly shows ONLY 4 tabs (Home/Calendar/Family/Chat) - tab-more is ABSENT (viewer_role='child' branch in (tabs)/_layout.tsx works). Confirmed with /api/families/me returning the joined family. (3) A11Y LABELS spot-check - source-verified that every icon-only testID listed in the request exposes a meaningful accessibilityLabel: home-search='Search', home-customize='Customize dashboard', home-chat='Open family chat', home-avatar='Your profile'; tab buttons expose aria-label AND aria-selected via accessibilityState.selected; sos-button='Send emergency SOS alert to your family', emergency-back='Go back'; chat-send-btn='Send message', chat-mic-btn='Hold to record a voice message', chat-image-btn='Attach a photo', conv-back='Go back'; cal-prev='Previous month', cal-next='Next month', fab-create-event has accessibilityLabel; vault-back='Go back', vault-lock-btn (labelled), vault-add-btn='Add to vault'; chores-back='Go back', toggle-add-chore='Add a chore'/'Close add chore'. KidsHome tiles and SimpleHome tiles both expose accessibilityRole='button' + accessibilityLabel per-tile. (4) REGRESSION with Simple Home OFF - adult testdad's full dashboard renders (nudge / header row / status strip / attention / today / etc.); tab-calendar opens the calendar; tab-chat opens chat; tapping tiles routes correctly. No red-screens; only the pre-existing benign warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' in console. No expo/react-native deprecated packages introduced by this batch.
action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: SimpleHome tile 'simple-tile-birthdays' currently opens /(tabs)/calendar (same route as Family Calendar tile). Consider deep-linking to a birthdays view or the Birthdays section anchor if one exists, so grandparents get a distinct destination.

Optional: on the /timeline/vault.tsx legacy screen the Pressable at line 58 (testID='vault-back') is missing accessibilityLabel. Not in the review scope (the active /vault/index.tsx path is fully labelled), but worth cleaning up during a future a11y pass.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/dashboard.ts:7-13 personaOf(me) returns 'child' when me.is_child || me.role==='child' - verified via /api/families/me for the joined kid account (member.role='child'), so the Home file's `if (persona === 'child')` short-circuit renders KidsHome. Correct.

frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:28-32,50 fetches /api/families/me on mount and hides the 'More' tab when viewer_role==='child' via the visibleTabs filter. Verified in DOM: only 4 tabs render for the child; keys are still preserved for the underlying Expo Router but not rendered - no navigation crashes.

frontend/src/components/home/SimpleHome.tsx:47-58 each tile is a Pressable with accessibilityRole='button' and accessibilityLabel=t.label + testID derived from the first word (`simple-tile-<first>`), so IDs stay stable even if tile labels change - matches the review request IDs exactly.

frontend/src/components/home/KidsHome.tsx:125-152 kids chore rows use accessibilityRole='checkbox' with accessibilityState.checked and a descriptive accessibilityLabel ('<title>, done/not done') - great screen-reader behaviour. Toggle handler is optimistic then reconciles via /api/chores/<id>/{complete|uncomplete}, verified with the Make Bed toggle round-trip.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:190-208 places the Kids Mode branch BEFORE the Simple Home branch, so a child user with simpleHome flag would still get the friendlier KidsHome (correct precedence). Guard uses `home && persona==='child'` so the empty first-render doesn't flash the wrong home.
frontend/app/settings/accessibility.tsx toggle-simple-home routes through ThemeContext.setSimpleHome which persists to storage - verified across nav (Home->More->Home) that the flag survives. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login submit testID is 'login-submit-btn' (NOT 'login-submit'). Invite code endpoint is GET /api/families/invite and returns {invite_code, family_name}; the auth token is stored in localStorage under key 'fh_auth_token' as a bare JWT string (no JSON quotes wrapper on web). To create a child-role account programmatically: POST /api/auth/register {email,password,name} -> login via UI -> onboarding shows join/create; use join-family-option + invite-code-input + join-continue-btn, then claim any pending profile via claim-<member_id> (Priya=parent/Mom, Aarav & Anaya = child, Meera = grandparent). The Sharma family invite 9651EDC0 already had Anaya claimed by a prior run; Aarav was the first available CHILD profile in this run. When toggling Simple Home ON, the Home tab still keeps its testID 'tab-index' so navigation back from a tile always works. The 'Emergency' screen hides the bottom tab bar - use router.back() (browser back) or navigate via the More tab BEFORE opening Emergency. AffectionAnimation overlay ('affection-dismiss') may appear on login; dismiss it before interacting with header icons.
